reason: The report controls for collab_index_2023, a 2023 post-treatment variable that sits downstream of remote_share (corr about 0.51) and is also strongly tied to the outcome, so it is a mediator or collider. Conditioning on it produces the -2.7 'negative effect'. Without it, using only 2020 pre-period controls, the estimate is about -0.28 (SE 0.24) and not significant, so the conclusion is not supported.
